device.description: 10-bit 50-200 kSPS 4-channel SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc104s021q-q1.pdf (SNAS278H) p.2 Figure 1 pinout and pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 output coding and timing specifications, p.7 Figure 4 serial timing, p.16-17 using the ADC104S021 (frame, control register Tables 2-4), p.17 transfer function

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal control register (no address), loaded through DIN; power-up channel IN1

commands.name: Control Register
commands.note: DIN bits 7:0 on the first 8 rising SCLK edges of each 16-clock conversion (Table 2 Control Register Bits); CH = ADD1:ADD0 selects the channel of the next conversion

pages: p.2 Figure 1 pinout and pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 output coding and timing specifications, p.7 Figure 4 serial timing, p.16-17 using the ADC104S021 (frame, control register Tables 2-4), p.17 transfer function (VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 V to VA; tEN 30 ns, tACC 30 ns, tDIS 20 ns (CS rise); DOUT: Z3-Z0 zeros, DB9-DB0, two zeros; DIN: DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC x3)
notModeled: analog inputs; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (the result is the 0 V code 0x000 at once)

channel selection is pipelined: the control byte picks the input of the next conversion (ADD1 ADD0: 00 IN1 (default), 01 IN2, 10 IN3, 11 IN4; ADD2 don't care); the 0 V result is the same on every channel, so only CTRL changes

continuous conversions inside one CS-low frame (each further 16 SCLKs is a new conversion, track mode re-entered after each 16th rising edge): modeled with a stream frame (one control byte per 16 bits) and idle "repeat" for the output frame
SPI mode 3 chosen (DOUT changes on SCLK falling edges, DIN sampled on rising edges); the datasheet allows SCLK high or low at CS fall within tCSU/tCLH (mode 0 works the same)
power-down while CS is high and between conversions (no visible digital effect)
tCSU / tCLH and SCLK frequency limits; frames must contain a multiple of 16 SCLKs
the datasheet (adc104s021q-q1.pdf) covers both ADC104S021 (CIMM) and the AEC-Q100 ADC104S021Q (QIMM); same digital behaviour
variants: ADC104S051 is the same pinout and protocol at another sample-rate range (separate datasheet); ADC082S/ADC122S (2-ch) and ADC084S/ADC124S (4-ch) are the 8/12-bit parts
